choice_criteria.no-defect: The text does not exhibit this defect.
choice_criteria.insufficient-context: The text is too short or ambiguous to decide.

descriptions.orwell.stale-figure: text that is a worn figure. State the fact it stands in for
descriptions.orwell.compound-preposition: fixed by: Substitute the single word
descriptions.orwell.unsupported-evaluative: text that evaluates without evidence. Add the number, or cut the word
descriptions.prose-discipline.frozen-verb: text that freezes the action in a noun. Use the plain verb
descriptions.prose-discipline.run-on: This sentence stitches N independent ideas together; the limit is N. Split it
descriptions.prose-discipline.phrasal-verb: fixed by: Replace with the plain verb the list names
descriptions.prose-discipline.marketing-lexicon: text that is sales register. State the measurable fact instead
descriptions.prose-discipline.bidirectional-hedge: text that hedges in both directions, so the two halves cancel. State which one the evidence supports
descriptions.prose-discipline.hedged-hedge: text that hedges a hedge. Keep at most one, or state the claim plainly
descriptions.ste-descriptive.sentence-too-long-descri: This sentence has N words. Use twenty-five or fewer
descriptions.ste-descriptive.paragraph-too-many-sente: This paragraph has N sentences. Use six or fewer
descriptions.ste-nouns.multiword-noun-too-long: This noun stack has N words. Use three or fewer
descriptions.ste-practices.phrasal-verb: fixed by: Replace the phrasal verb with the single verb
descriptions.ste-practices.inconsistent-wording-for-s: This step is worded two ways in one document
descriptions.ste-practices.omitted-conjunction-that: fixed by: Insert "that" after the reporting verb
descriptions.ste-practices.unclear-pronoun: Pronoun may have more than one referent
descriptions.ste-practices.unclear-demonstrative-this: fixed by: Replace the demonstrative with the noun phrase it refers to
descriptions.ste-practices.false-friend-term: fixed by: Replace the word with the one that matches your intended sense
descriptions.ste-practices.latin-abbreviation: fixed by: Replace the abbreviation with the English words, or delete the trailing list
descriptions.ste-practices.gendered-or-exclusionary-l: fixed by: Replace the term with the inclusive alternative, unless it is an identifier
descriptions.ste-practices.possessive-form-unclear: Possessive may be unclear. Consider "of the.."
descriptions.ste-procedural.sentence-too-long-procedu: This instruction has N words. Use twenty or fewer
descriptions.ste-procedural.multiple-instructions-per: This step carries more than one instruction
descriptions.ste-procedural.instruction-not-imperativ: This step is not in the imperative
descriptions.ste-procedural.condition-after-command: The condition follows the command. Put the condition first
descriptions.ste-procedural.note-gives-instruction: This note gives an instruction. A note only gives information
descriptions.ste-punctuation.semicolon-used: The semicolon is not permitted. Write two sentences
descriptions.ste-punctuation.hyphen-group-too-long: This hyphen group joins more than three words
descriptions.ste-punctuation.colon-terminates-sentenc: The lead-in before the colon has N words. Use the sentence cap
descriptions.ste-safety.safety-block-does-not-start-w: This safety block does not open with a command or condition
descriptions.ste-safety.safety-block-missing-conseque: This safety block gives no explanation of the risk or the result
descriptions.ste-sentences.omitted-word-or-contractio: Omitted word or contraction. Write the full form
descriptions.ste-sentences.complex-text-not-in-vertic: This sentence carries N coordinated items. Use a vertical list
descriptions.ste-sentences.vertical-list-lead-in-miss: The sentence before a vertical list must end with a colon
descriptions.ste-sentences.missing-article-or-determi: fixed by: Add "the", "a", "an", "this", or "these" before the noun
descriptions.ste-verbs.verb-form-not-listed: fixed by: Use a listed form of the verb
descriptions.ste-verbs.complex-tense: Complex verb construction. Use a simple present, past, or future tense
descriptions.ste-verbs.auxiliary-stacking: Auxiliary stack. Give the action directly
descriptions.ste-verbs.passive-voice: Passive voice. Name the actor and use the active voice
descriptions.ste-words.word-outside-controlled-vocabu: text that is on this project's word blocklist
descriptions.ste-words.approved-word-substitution: fixed by: Replace the flagged word with the listed replacement
descriptions.ste-words.obligation-word-substitution: fixed by: Replace with "must" where the requirement is real. Where it is genuinely optional, say so plainly ("optional", "you can") rather than hedging the obligation word. In a document using RFC 2119 keywords, write them in capitals
descriptions.ste-words.word-used-in-wrong-part-of-spe: fixed by: Rewrite so the word carries its permitted part of speech, or choose a different word
descriptions.ste-words.verb-or-adjective-form-not-per: fixed by: Use a listed form of the word, or rewrite the sentence
descriptions.ste-words.noun-used-as-verb: fixed by: Rewrite with a verb, and keep the noun as a noun
descriptions.ste-words.slang-or-jargon-term: text that is slang or jargon. Use a plain term
descriptions.ste-words.inconsistent-term-for-same-thi: fixed by: Pick one term and use it in every sentence
descriptions.ste-words.verb-used-as-noun: fixed by: Replace the verb-as-noun with the noun form, or rewrite with the verb
